notes.title: 2025.3.14 Spring sale Update
notes.content:
1. New Dungeon: Bronze Echoes
(Unlocked after completing all explorations, accessible through the Crystal Ball dialogue)
(Includes 19 new artifacts, 12 new monsters, and 10 new scenes)

2. New Dungeon: Endless Abyss
(Unlocked after completing Bronze Echoes, accessible through the Crystal Ball dialogue)
(Can be re-entered to farm resources)

3. Background Gameplay
The game can now run in the background.

notes.title: 2025.2.17Update
notes.content: Fixed the bug in the automatic explanation feature.

notes.title: 2025.2.14Update
notes.content:
Fixed lag caused by too many tourist routes.
Fixed a bug where some archive achievements could not be completed.
Fixed a cloud save bug.
Fixed incorrect display in the monster guide.

Optimized the storyline text in the Longshan Culture Black Pottery Goblet.
Improved some English translations.

notes.title: 2025.2.13Update
notes.content:
Fixed the bug of the display of the acquisition channels for decorations.
Fixed the resolution adaptation issue.
Fixed the potential bug when the backpack is full.

Fixed the bug that may prevent achievements from popping up.
Added 2 cultural relics, which can be obtained by opening stores.
Added explanatory texts for cultural relics.
Increased the quantity sold in the store.
Optimized the gameplay of Advent.
Optimized the stacking quantity in the warehouse.
Optimized the position of tips in the placement interface.

notes.title: 2025.2.12Update
notes.content:
Fixed the dispatch bug.
Fixed the potential bug that could occur when opening a store for the first time.
Fixed the rotation issue of some furniture.
Fixed the bug related to warehouse page - switching.
Fixed the bug of backpack upgrading.

Added gold coins after achieving 600 combos.
Added 1 level to the 2nd layer, 2 levels to the 3rd layer, and 2 levels to the 4th layer.
Added 6 relic drops.
Increased the selling probability of adhesives and crystal - charging items.
Increased the quantity of wallpapers and floors for sale.
The decoration interface no longer restricts the view range of the museum.

notes.title: 2025.2.11Update
notes.content:
BUG Fixes
Fixed the bug where the expansion was invisible.
Fixed the issue of non - support for large resolutions. A temporary solution has been implemented, and further optimization will be carried out later.
Fixed the bug where the character got stuck in a tree underground.
Fixed the bug in the "Si Yi" mission.
Fixed the text bug in the prosperity assessment.
Fixed the bug that occurred after reaching combo 600.
Fixed the achievement bug.
Fixed the problem with cloud saves.

Game Optimization:
Added guidance for standing signs.
Added red dot prompts for obtaining new items and new decorations.
Increased the number of crystal charging items for prosperity level - up.
Added a disappearing animation for the interaction of exploration artifact fragments.
Added the display of NPC head icons when there are plot options.

notes.title: "Museum No. 9" demo update announcement (V1.0.0.001)
"Museum No. 9" event: comments and add to the wish list to get a game key！
notes.content:
Hello, friends who follow "Museum No. 9"!
In order to let everyone better experience the domestic independent game "Museum No. 9" we made, the producer will give you benefits! Follow "Museum No. 9" and add to the wish list, comment on this post, after the game is launched, Randomly draw players in the comment area to give this game's key!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404170/_/

Participation method: 
Follow, Comment, Add to wishlist

Participants: 
For every 100 people in the comment area, 5 more players will be selected to receive game keys.
If the number of people in the comment area is less than 100 at the beginning, 5 players will still be selected to receive game keys.

Event start time: July 5, 2024

Event end time: Game launch date (expected in the fourth quarter of 2024)

Everyone is welcome to actively participate! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/56adec7e32e6aca676c3c47ccab0bc9d4cd6d634.jpg
Game Introduction:
The game takes place in an era when human civilization is dying. You will run an "Old World" museum in a magical civilization that is reborn from the ashes. The game is an independent game of simulation management + Rogue. You will simulate running a museum during the day, and [rogue exploration in the wild at night to obtain materials and dig up artifacts.

Game features: 
●Free museum construction
——Rich furniture system, various styles for you to choose
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/38c54e5aac485a925f8459b93f0b23f04ae1fa4f.jpg
●Cultural relics restoration
——Collecting cultural relics fragments and restoring them, passing on the torch is a great achievement
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/265a4e577b6a95792c8b17e0d7b3adc5bed422f9.jpg
●Simulation business
——Rationally plan routes and skills to get more rewards and unlock scale
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/d031fd20ef458998535b39e117f4c0c04e2df061.jpg
●Material production
——Special furniture and handicraft production, help museum construction and operation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/d1db94349d948bd7f86a98ad588cbf870163f606.jpg
●Adventure mode
——Light rogue mode night adventure, dig more materials and artifacts
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/a2992c97f90f1a54dfc9cef1e57acb52f7efa86f.jpg
●Specialized characters
——Specialized NPCs help with management, making the simulation journey colorful
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/77677d9200889cb5419e2947306027e838df3058.jpg
●Room interface
——Unique selection interface, where a variety of magic facilities gather
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053509/f66dde83577a2a5ff42c61d1f9c7459bc8e54a30.jpg
The game has many fun features waiting for you to explore!
